children.game_version: Follow-the-leader longways progression game where top dancers invent simple skipping patterns.

avoid: High relevé on balls of feet
seniors.seated_version: Execute upper body hand connections, moulinet arm stars, and rhythmic foot tapping while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform longways figures at a slow walking pace without jumping or rising high on the balls of the feet.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo with small steps to maintain balance.

learning_units.description: Executing Scotch reel setting and heying

social_formats.description: Longways set of couples performing figures and progressing
Square set of four couples for cotillion or quadrille

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Held in a variety of graceful positions during waltzing and turns
movement_profile.footwork: Ranging from simple skipping steps to elaborate ballet-style movements and fancy setting steps
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Longways facing lines, square sets, or linear reels
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes leaps in variants like the sauteuse waltz
movement_profile.partnering: Couples dancing figures together, progressing along lines, or turning in closed waltz hold
movement_profile.posture: Up on the balls of the feet with graceful arm positions

signature_moves.description: Fancy steps danced in place during reels or country dances.
signature_moves.name: Setting

signature_moves.description: Interlacing paths woven through a line of three or four dancers.
signature_moves.name: Heying

signature_moves.description: A right-hand or left-hand star figure performed in square cotillion sets.
signature_moves.name: Moulinet

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Lively and bouncy rather than smooth and stately
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid dancing in a smooth, slow, or stately manner, which misrepresents authentic period technique.

music_profile.meter: 2/4 or 3/4 depending on the specific dance
music_profile.musical_form: Sectional sets of figures (quadrilles) or repeated tunes with chorus and changes (cotillions)
music_profile.sound_description: Bright, structured dance music supporting energetic skipping, setting, and stepping across various meters.

basic_steps: Moulinet / Star (right-hand or left-hand turn in square or set)
teaching.formation: Longways sets (couples in two facing lines), squares (cotillions and quadrilles), or lines of 3-4 (reels).
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic line progressions and skips; advanced dancers execute ballet-style setting footwork.
teaching.rhythm: Variable by dance format; includes 2/4 for sauteuse and 3/4 for waltz.
